fields.title-post: How IA Scan works: Innovorder's artificial intelligence tray scanner
fields.rt-blog-html:
At a time when artificial intelligence is permeating our daily lives, tray scanning with AI stands out as a revolutionary innovation in the foodservice sector. But how exactly does this technology work?

Video presentation of Innovorder's AI-enabled flat-bed scanning system

Innovorder, a pioneer in innovation, presents its latest innovation: IA Scan. This technology is revolutionizing foodservice by cutting throughput times by a factor of 3, to an average of 500 passes per hour.

Claire, Product Manager at Innovorder, explains how IA Scan, the smoothest artificial intelligence flatbed scanner on the market, works.

‍

‍

What is a flatbed scan with artificial intelligence?

A tray scanner is an electronic device designed to automatically recognize items on a guest's tray using an integrated camera system and artificial intelligence software. 

Using powerful image recognition algorithms, it identifies each item, compares it with the database and calculates the total cost of the tray. The beauty of this system lies in its accuracy and speed, transforming the traditional checkout process into a smooth, error-free experience.

‍

How IA Scan works

Guest side

For your guests, nothing could be simpler: they place their tray on the tray scanner and scan their badge. They then receive their receipt by e-mail in just a few seconds, before going to lunch.

Operator side

The products of the day must be entered by the operator in order to train the artificial intelligence. Indeed, like all AIs, IA Scan must learn to recognize foods and containers through a series of photos, before memorizing them and being able to identify them automatically. For this reason, products need to be recorded by the AI before, during or after service.

‍

The 4 benefits of IA Scan

Fluidity

Tray scanning with AI reduces throughput times by a factor of 3, allowing diners to enjoy their break more and wait less in line.

👉 Find out more: discover our webinar hosted by foodservice experts "AI at the service of foodservice".

Reliability

It features the most advanced artificial intelligence on the market, with a recognition rate of over 97%. It recognizes containers and contents, and continues to pay your guests in offline mode, even if the network is lost.

Profitability

By streamlining the checkout process, IA Scan boosts restaurant traffic by 10-15%.

👉 Find out about the 6 other advantages of flatbed scanning with artificial intelligence

Simplicity

IA Scan simplifies the day-to-day work of operational staff, thanks to a practical, easy-to-use tracking and parameter-setting application. What's more, orders placed via IA Scan automatically feed back into the back office.
